propositions: Three pure filesystem primitives (_resolve_tracker_git_dir, _ticket_dirs, _dir_is_archived) are defined in fsck_repair.py but have no repair-related logic and are imported by seven production modules across the codebase, creating an inverted dependency.
The three primitives must be moved to gitutil.py (a stdlib-only leaf module) to align their location with their semantic domain and eliminate the structural inversion.

fsck.py and fsck_repair.py must maintain backward-compatible module-level re-exports of the three names to preserve existing test compatibility surfaces that use monkeypatch.setattr and direct attribute access.

The move introduces no circular imports because gitutil imports only stdlib modules and function-local rebar imports, while all consumers are _commands modules that import _store (the existing dependency direction).
